adversarial_claim: A security authority's signature alone holds an agent, an incident of another operation holds this one, or a hold hides on a dimension.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Confirmed incident': evidence_refs cites the confirmed incident record of its task and operation; this report cites none (14.2: the receiver verifies evidence references), so it is UNQUALIFIED and places no hold (14.6 rule 12, 15.4).

Draft 14.5, row 'Confirmed incident', and 15.4: an authority reports each incident under the task and operation it concerns. The record cited is the incident of invoice-read-operation-0003, not of this report's operation, so the report is UNQUALIFIED and places no hold.

Draft 14.5, row 'Confirmed incident', and 14.6 rule 12: a security authority's SECURITY report with another result or dimension than FAILURE on none is UNQUALIFIED and places no hold, so one authority cannot hold one task and operation twice through a second dimension (15.4).
